title: Warm Syrian Style Baked Potatoes
description: A flavorful and comforting dish inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine, featuring warm baked potatoes topped with a mix of spices and herbs.
instructions: Scrub the potatoes clean and dry them with a paper towel.
Poke some holes in each potato with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Rub the potatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the potatoes directly on the middle rack of the oven.
Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Top each potato with chopped parsley and crumbled feta cheese (if using).
